## Get unique SEO-COPD GpCs

```{r}
rDMPs.wbacon.unique = rDMPs.wbacon[rDMPs.wbacon$CpG.id %in% unique.cpgs.SEO,]
```

```{r}
# read GTF file with gene locations
gtf <- read.table('../../docs/genes.gtf', header = F, skip = 5, sep="\t")
genes.info <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "gene",]
colnames(genes.info) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score","strand", "frame","attribute"
  )

df <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(genes.info$attribute, ';', 7))

ENS.ID <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V1, ' ', 2))$V2
gene.symbol <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V4, ' ', 3))$V3

genes.info$ENS.ID <- ENS.ID
genes.info$gene.symbol <- gene.symbol
genes.info$attribute <- NULL
genes.info$gene.symbol[genes.info$gene.symbol == "THRA1/BTR"] <- "SKAP1-AS2"

head(genes.info)

```

## Transcription start site (TSS)

```{r}
cpgs.genes <- list()
cpgs.genes$ids <- DMPs.wbacon_annot$CpG.id
genes.close.to.cpgs <- list()

for (i in c(1:nrow(DMPs.wbacon_annot))) {
  gene.selection <- genes.info %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      seqname == DMPs.wbacon_annot[i, "chr"],
      start %in% c(
        (DMPs.wbacon_annot[i, "pos"][[1]]-1000000):(DMPs.wbacon_annot[i, "pos"][[1]]+1000000))
      )%>%
    dplyr::mutate(distance.tss = DMPs.wbacon_annot[i, "pos"][[1]] - start)
  genes.close.to.cpgs[DMPs.wbacon_annot[i, "CpG.id"]][[1]] <- as.matrix(gene.selection)
}

cpgs.genes$genes <- genes.close.to.cpgs
rm(gene.selection, genes.close.to.cpgs)

head(DMPs.wbacon_annot)
```
### Comet

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# Sample data: create a dataframe with chromosomes, CpG locations, and differential methylation values

data <- data.frame(
  CpG = DMPs.wbacon_annot$CpG.id,
  chr = DMPs.wbacon_annot$chr,
  logFC = DMPs.wbacon_annot$logFC,  # Random beta differences
  p_value = DMPs.wbacon_annot$pValue.bacon
)

# Optional: filter significant CpG sites
#sig_data <- data %>%
#  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05)

# Create a basic comet plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = chr, y = logFC)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(size = -log10(p_value),
        color = logFC
        ),
    width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0
    ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comet Plot of Differential Methylation by Chromosome",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "Methylation Difference (logFC)"
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
  scale_size(
    range = c(1, 10),
    guide = guide_legend(title = "-log10(p-value)")
    ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")


```

```{r}
significance.cutoff <- significance.cutoff.h.s.u <- 0.05 # FDR
fc.cutoff <- 0

significance.filter <- (function() {
  sco <- significance.cutoff
  fco <- fc.cutoff
  
  function(df) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fc.include = dplyr::case_when(
          fco == 0 ~ TRUE,
          TRUE ~ abs(logFC) > log2(fco)
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        adj.P.Val <= sco &
          fc.include
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-fc.include)
  }
})()
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

#options(bitmapType='cairo')

for (i in c(1:nrow(top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot))) {
  # create dir with cpg name
  cpg <- top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot[i,"CpG.id"]
  script.result.dir.cpg <- file.path(script.result.dir, cpg)
  dir.create(script.result.dir.cpg, recursive=TRUE)
  # add m.values to pheno.data
  current.pheno.data <- cbind(pheno.data, meth[rownames(pheno.data), cpg])
  names(current.pheno.data)[ncol(current.pheno.data)] <- "Methylation"
  # add beta values to pheno.data
  current.pheno.data <- cbind(current.pheno.data, betas[rownames(pheno.data), cpg])
  names(current.pheno.data)[ncol(current.pheno.data)] <- "Betas"
  # 
  design <- model.matrix(
    ~0 + Methylation,
    data = current.pheno.data
  )
  
  # select the genes close to cpg
  rna.selection <- cpgs.genes$genes[cpg][[1]][,"ENS.ID"]
  rna.expression.current <- as.matrix(rna.expression[, pheno.data$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq])
  colnames(rna.expression.current) <- rownames(pheno.data)
  
  # 
  rna.expression.normalized.current <- rna.expression.current %>%
    limma::voom() %>% # logCPM+ est mean-var relat, ready for lm
    as.matrix()
  
  # QC of current genes
  DGEL <- edgeR::DGEList(rna.expression.current)
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(DGEL, design)
  DGEL <- DGEL[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
  DGEL <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(DGEL, method = "TMM")
  
  # run the model
  y <- limma::voom(DGEL, design, plot = F)
  
  original.fit <- limma::lmFit(
    y,
    design
  )
  
  adjusted.fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(original.fit, coef = "Methylation")
  adjusted.fit <- limma::eBayes(adjusted.fit, 0.05) # Calculate the t-statistics
  
  current.results <- limma::topTable(
    adjusted.fit,
    adjust = "BH",
    coef = "Methylation",
    sort.by = "P",
    number = nrow(adjusted.fit)
  )
  
  current.results <- current.results[rna.selection,]
  current.results <- current.results[complete.cases(current.results),]

  current.results$adj.P.Val <- p.adjust(current.results$P.Value, method = "BH")
  
  current.results %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    readr::write_csv(
      file = file.path(script.result.dir.cpg, "results.csv")
    )
  
  current.results %>%
    significance.filter() %>%
    readr::write_csv(
      file = file.path(script.result.dir.cpg, "results.sign.csv")
    )
  results.cpgs[cpg][[1]] <- as.matrix(current.results)


  if (!(length(rna.selection) == 0)) {
    for (j in c(1:length(rna.selection))) {
      current.ensembl.id <- cpgs.genes$genes[cpg][[1]][j,"ENS.ID"]
     # if (rna.results[which(rna.results$ensembl_gene_id == current.ensembl.id),]$PValue <= 0.05) { ###
      #  print("match rna results and current cpg-gene")
        current.pheno.data.w.gene <- cbind(current.pheno.data, rna.expression.normalized.current[j,])
        current.gene <- cpgs.genes$genes[cpg][[1]][j,"gene.symbol"]
        current.ensembl.id <- cpgs.genes$genes[cpg][[1]][j,"ENS.ID"]
        
        names(current.pheno.data.w.gene)[ncol(current.pheno.data.w.gene)] <- "RNA.expr"
        current.pheno.data.w.gene <- current.pheno.data.w.gene %>%
            dplyr::filter(abs((RNA.expr - mean(RNA.expr))/sd(RNA.expr)) <= 3,
            abs((Betas - mean(Betas))/sd(Betas)) <= 3)
        
        #group = group[1:length(group)-1]
        scatter.current <- ggplot(current.pheno.data.w.gene, aes(x=RNA.expr, y=Betas)) +
          geom_point(size=5, aes(colour=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N), group=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N))) +
          geom_smooth(method='lm', mapping = aes(color=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N)), se = FALSE) +
          ylab("Methylation B values") +
          xlab("RNA expression") +
          labs(title = paste("Scatterplot of ", cpg, " methylation vs ", current.gene),
               subtitle = paste("FDR p-value :", current.results[j, "adj.P.Val"])) +
          ggprism::theme_prism() +
          ggprism::scale_shape_prism() +
          theme(text=element_text(size=30))
          
        sub.title1 <- paste("FDR p-value :", top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot[
          which(
            top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot$CpG.id == cpg),]$adj.P.Val, "and ")
        sub.title2 <- paste(" :", round(-1*(
            top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot[
              which(
                top10_DMPs.wbacon_annot$CpG.id == cpg),]$logFC), 5)
            )
        
        boxplot.cpg <- ggplot(
          current.pheno.data.w.gene,
          mapping = aes(
            x=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N),
            group=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N),
            y=Betas)
          ) +
          geom_boxplot(aes(colour=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N), group=factor(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N))) +
         
          geom_point(size=5, position = "jitter") +
          ylab("Methylation - B values") +
          xlab("Group") +
          labs(
            title = paste("Boxplot compairing",cpg, "in Controls(ES) vs SEO-COPD"),
            subtitle = substitute(
              paste(st1, log[2]*FC, st2),
              list(
                st1=sub.title1,
                st2=sub.title2))
            ) +
          ggprism::theme_prism() +
          ggprism::scale_shape_prism() +
          theme(text=element_text(size=30))
        
        p <- boxplot.cpg + scatter.current
        
        png(
          filename = file.path(script.result.dir.cpg,
                               paste(cpg, "vs", current.gene, "plot.png", sep = "_")
                               ),
          width =2800,
          height = 1800,
          units = "px",
          pointsize = 24,
          type = "cairo"
          )
        
        print(p)
        dev.off()
        
        # add comet plots here
        
      }
    }
 
}
```

# Comet plots

```{r}
make.comet <- function(mydata.frame, be.verbose=FALSE) {
  
  cpg.dir <- file.path(results.dir, cpg)
  dir.create(cpg.dir, recursive=T)
  setwd(cpg.dir)
  
  mydata.betas <- t(rna.expression[mydata.frame$TargetID,])
  listcormatrix.data.raw <- as.data.frame(cor(mydata.betas)) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "CpG.id") %>%
    dplyr::select(-CpG.id)
  rownames(listcormatrix.data.raw) <- colnames(listcormatrix.data.raw)
  
  listcormatrix.data.raw <- as.matrix(listcormatrix.data.raw)
  
  myinfofile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("mydata_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))
  mycorrelationfile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("mycorrelation_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))
  myexpressfile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("myexpression_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))
  
  write.table(mydata.frame, myinfofile, sep="\t")
  write.table(listcormatrix.data.raw, mycorrelationfile, sep="\t")
  write.table(myexpress.frame, myexpressfile, sep = "\t")
  
  comet.web(config.file=configfile,
            mydata.file=myinfofile,
            cormatrix.file=mycorrelationfile,
            mydata.ref=cpg,
            pval.threshold=0.05,
            start=min(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
            end=max(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
            image.title=paste(cpg, " methylation in COPD vs Controls", sep = ""),
            image.name=paste(cpg, "_coMet_plot", sep = ""),
            image.type = "pdf",
            print.image=TRUE,
            verbose = be.verbose)
}

```

```{r}

    mydata.frame <- curr.cpg.frame %>%
```

```{r}
library("coMET")
library("rtracklayer")

cpg.dir <- file.path(result.eqtm.comet, cpg)
dir.create(cpg.dir, recursive=T)
setwd(cpg.dir)
mydata.betas <- t(rna.expression[mydata.frame$TargetID,])

listcormatrix.data.raw <- as.data.frame(cor(mydata.betas)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "CpG.id") %>%
  dplyr::select(-CpG.id)

rownames(listcormatrix.data.raw) <- colnames(listcormatrix.data.raw)
listcormatrix.data.raw <- as.matrix(listcormatrix.data.raw)

myinfofile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("mydata_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))
mycorrelationfile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("mycorrelation_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))
myexpressfile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste("myexpression_", cpg ,".txt", sep = ""))

write.table(mydata.frame, myinfofile, sep = "\t")
write.table(listcormatrix.data.raw, mycorrelationfile, sep="\t")
#write.table(myexpress.frame, myexpressfile, sep = "\t")

comet.web(config.file=configfile,
          mydata.file=myinfofile,
          cormatrix.file=mycorrelationfile,
          mydata.ref=cpg,
          pval.threshold=0.05,
          start=min(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
          end=max(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
          image.title=paste(cpg, " methylation in SEO-COPD vs Controls", sep = ""),
          image.name=paste(cpg, "_coMet_plot", sep = ""),
          image.type = "pdf",
          print.image=TRUE,
          verbose = TRUE)
```
